column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_tutorial.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Fills the 0x120-byte list window descriptor win (0x12200 + slot * 0x120) for message slot slot_index and opens it with ui_open_list_window. Slot 6 (question): anchor from slot +8/+10, width 0x1c2, measures the caption (first text line, duel_core_tutorial_measure_caption with width 0x6a80 = 0x1aa << 6) into slot +0x424 in pixels and offsets the list by that height + 0x10, item count from slot +0x420, item draw callback duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item (descriptor +0xfc = 0x440). Slots 7/8 (hint and message): skin GIM 0x12ed4, width 0xdc (7) or 0x136 (8), text = slot +0xe; in Japanese (save_get_language 0) the font end-y offset is set to 0xc0 while opening. Other slots (9): fixed box (0x28, 0x23) 400 x 0xc0, text = slot +0xe, descriptor +0x8c = 1 in Japanese and, when slot +0x40e is non-zero, the custom draw callback +0x100 = entry slot +0x40e of the table 0xf6f0 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_lesson_image_01..06 at indices 1-6). No return value. Side effects: win, slot +0x424, font end-y offset (back to 0 at the end), window list. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_update_list).

Returns the message-window slot record 0xf870 + index * 0x428 (ten slots: 0-5 speaker windows, 6 question list, 7 hint, 8 message, 9 large window). No side effects. Callers: 4 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup, duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_get_state, duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_set_text, duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_close).
Scans a UTF-16 text and returns the character after the next newline (10), or NULL when the terminating NUL comes first. No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item).

column2: void * duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item(void *list, uint item, int x, int y)
column3: List item draw callback of the question window: the question text is the slot-6 text 0x1116e, line 0 the caption and lines 1..n the choices. For item 0 it first draws the caption (copied into a 0x100-character buffer) above the list at (x + 2, y - caption height 0x11584 - 0xc), width 0x1aa; then it walks to line item + 1 and draws it at (x + 2, y + 1) with scale 0xe, black, shadow, through the font external list. Returns the advanced list pointer (unchanged when the line is missing). Side effects: font state, GE commands. No direct caller (descriptor +0xfc set by duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_open_list_window).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT pixel wrapper (identical machine code; the decompiler shows only the tail call): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Here it draws a question choice line. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item).

column2: void ui_window_draw_text_box_px(int x, int y, int width, int height, void *text)
column3: Copy of the BOOT pixel wrapper (identical machine code; the decompiler shows only the tail call): system_font_draw_text_box(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, height << 6, text, -1, 0). Here it draws the question caption. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item).

Per-frame callback of the speaker slots 0-5 (slot +0x41c = 0x624, called by duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all), on the slot state +4: 2 waits until the face animation of the current face entry (table 0x12d40 indexed by 0x12d80) is ready, then 3; 3 starts the talking face (duel_core_tutorial_set_face_anim(anim, 1, 1, expression +0xd)) and goes to 4; 4 goes to 5 once the message window stops sliding; in 4/5 the mouth follows ui_field_is_message_printing and when the message is acknowledged (duel_core_tutorial_is_message_done) the slot goes to 7 and the window's wait-input flag is cleared; 6/7 clear the active flag +0x418; 8 returns to state 0 once the window stops animating. Returns list unchanged. Side effects: slot +4/+0x418, face animation bits, 0x17e98. No direct caller (reached through slot +0x41c).

Per-frame callback of slots 6-9 (slot +0x41c = 0x7c0): state 3/4 opens the list window (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_open_list_window), goes to 5 (slots 6, 8, 9) or 6 with the active flag cleared (slot 7, the hint stays up) and falls into state 5 in the same frame; state 5 updates the window: slot 6 (question) on cancel (-2) goes to 0, on a choice calls duel_core_set_dialog_answer(choice + 1) and goes to 0, both clearing the active flag (-1 and -3 keep waiting); slots 8/9 go to 7 when the window is shown (byte +0xe9 = 3) and confirm is pressed; state 7 (slots 7-9) starts closing (ui_list_window_start_close), updates the window and goes to 8; state 8 updates the window and, once it reports closed (+0xe9 = 6), resets it and clears the active flag and, for every slot but 9, the state (slot 9 stays in state 8). Returns list unchanged. Side effects: slot state/active words, list windows 0x12200 + 0x120 * slot, dialog answer. No direct caller (reached through slot +0x41c).

Clears a message slot: the 0x400-byte text at +0xe and the words +4 (state), +0x410, +0x414 and +0x418 (active). No return value. Side effects: the slot. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup, duel_core_tutorial_init_graphics).

Initialises the message-window layer: clears the ten 0x428-byte slots at 0xf870 (index at +0, callback +0x41c = duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_update_talk), creates the field message window copy (ui_field_init_message_window(heap, x 0x27, width 400, font 0xe, wait input 1, style 3)), looks up tuto_duel01.gim (continue cursor), window02.gim and tuto_bigwin01.gim into 0x12ed0-0x12ed8 only when the archive pointer 0x17da4 is set (never, see tutorial.md), runs one window update, sets the callbacks of slots 6-9 to duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_update_list and clears the current slot 0x12d84. No return value. Side effects: 0xf870-0x12290, 0x12ed0-0x12ed8, the message window block 0x17dac. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_init).

Empty function: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set); second of three empty calls of duel_core_tutorial_cleanup, probably a hook left empty in this build (hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_cleanup).

When the message window is not sliding, finds the first speaker slot 0-5 in state 1 (pending): resets every speaker slot in state 7 to 0, looks the slot's character (+0xc) up in the face table (duel_core_tutorial_find_face_entry into 0x12d80), places the window (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_place_window) and sets the slot to state 2. Returns 1 when a pending slot was found, else 0. Side effects: slot states, 0x12d80, the message window. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all).

Positions the shared message window for a slot and gives it the slot's text: slots 0-5 get the speaker name world_get_character_name_string_first(0, character +0xc, with 0x14 mapped to 4) and one of six boxes (x 0x4f or 0xd8, y 0x14 or 0xd4, width 400 for slots 0/3, 0x105 otherwise) through duel_core_tutorial_place_message_window; slot 9 uses (0x4f, 0, 400) without a name; then ui_field_set_message_text(slot +0xe, name). No return value. Side effects: the message window block. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_activate_pending).

Searches the 8-entry face table at 0x12d40 (stride 8, character id in word +4) for character; on a match writes the index to *out_index and returns 1, else returns 0. Side effects: *out_index. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_activate_pending).

Draws the face of a speaker slot. Only when the archive 0x17da4 is set (never, see tutorial.md) it binds GIM 0x12ed0, sets the sprite render state, picks the per-slot corner (jump table 0xf4ec: slots 0/1 (4, 8), 2 (0x90, 8), 3/4 (4, 200), 5 (0x90, 200)) and draws the 0x47 x 0x47 frame there. The corner registers s1/s0 are written only in that branch, so with 0x17da4 = 0 the rest uses whatever they hold on entry. Then a 0x40 x 0x40 scissor at corner + 3, GE enable 2, the face animation of the current face entry (table 0x12d40 indexed by 0x12d80; duel_core_tutorial_draw_face_anim at corner x - 0xb, corner y + 3) and GE disable 2. No code in this module sets up a speaker slot, so this path does not run in practice. Returns the advanced list pointer (the result of system_ge_disable). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all).

Per-frame update and draw of the message windows on layer 9: activates a pending speaker slot, calls each slot's callback (+0x41c) for slots 0-9, updates the shared message window, then draws the list windows of slots 6-9 whose state is 3..8 (slot 9 first draws the large-window background from GIM 0x12ed8 pieces; slots 7/8 use font end-y 0xc0 in Japanese and draw the card icon of slot +0x40e at the window centre once the window is shown), the shared message window (ui_field_draw_message_window) and the faces of speaker slots in states 3..7. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 9, slot states, the message window. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_update_overlay).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup_default(int slot_index, uint face_code, short x, short y, uchar icon)
column3: 8-byte entry that falls into duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup with lines = 4 (the decompiler shows the shared body). Used for the message (slot 8) and hint (slot 7) windows. No return value. Side effects: as duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_open_message, duel_core_tutorial_open_hint_window).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_setup(int slot_index, uint face_code, short x, short y, uchar icon, int lines)
column3: Prepares a message slot: clears it; speaker slots 0-5 set the window's wait-input flag, store character face_code / 100 (0 becomes 2) at +0xc and expression face_code % 100 at +0xd, and become pending (state 1); slots 6/7 store lines at +0x420 (slot 9 also stores icon at +0x40e); every other slot stores x/y at +8/+0xa, clears +0xc/+0xd, stores icon at +0x40e and goes to state 3. Marks the slot active (+0x418) and current (0x12d84). No return value. Side effects: the slot, 0x12d84, 0x17e98. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_open_message).

Closes message windows: indices below 2 reset the speaker slots 0-2 and close the shared window, 2-4 reset slots 3-5; any other index clears its active flag and sets state 0 (slot 9, or a slot still in state 3) or 7 (closing). When a speaker slot was reset it also closes the shared window and sets its wait-input flag. Clears the current slot 0x12d84. No return value. Side effects: slot states, the message window state. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_close_hint_window).
Returns the state word +4 of message slot slot_index (0 = closed). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_is_message_open).

Sets the text of a message slot: NULL clears the 0x400-byte buffer +0xe, otherwise the text is copied with $-placeholders expanded (duel_core_tutorial_expand_placeholders, at most 0x200 characters). Marks the slot current (0x12d84). No return value. Side effects: slot text, 0x12d84. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_open_message, duel_core_tutorial_open_hint_window).

column2: void * duel_core_tutorial_draw_lesson_image(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int image)
column3: Draws lesson image tuto_duelimg%02d.gim (image) from the archive 0x17da4: white ambient, nearest filter, sprite 0x100 x 0x72 (image 1) or 0x100 x 0x5c, centred in the box (x, y, width, height). Returns at once when 0x17da4 is 0, which is always (dead code, see rel_tutorial.md). Returns the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands (none in practice). No direct caller (the six 8-byte entries duel_core_tutorial_draw_lesson_image_01..06, 0x1554-0x157c, jump to it with the image in t1 and the height in t0; they are the list window custom draw callbacks +0x100 of the table 0xf6f0).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite_noflip(void *list, int gim, int x, int y, int width, int height, int u, int v, int tex_w, int tex_h, uint color)
column3: Calls duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite with the same eleven arguments and both flip flags 0. Returns nothing. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite(void *list, int gim, int x, int y, int width, int height, int u, int v, int tex_w, int tex_h, uint color, int flip_uv, int flip_xy)
column3: Draws a sprite from one of the module's GIM textures: sets the sprite render state (duel_core_tutorial_set_sprite_render_state), writes the vertex colour color (system_ge_write_color), binds the GIM pointer 0x00012ed0 + gim x 4 (field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0) and draws with duel_core_tutorial_draw_sprite_scaled(list, x, y, width, height, u, v, tex_w, tex_h, flip_uv, flip_xy). Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3 and 9-13 on the stack. Returns nothing usable. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all, duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite_noflip).

Opens the in-lesson prompt reached with START: clears and fills the list window descriptor 0x12da8 (text +0x84 = system message 0x1f, width 0xf0, button style 3 in the low nibble of +0xca = buttons 2 and 3, highlighted button +0xd3 and cancel target +0xd4 = 3, option bits 1 and 5 of +0xc8), opens it, centres it on the 480 x 272 screen (y + 0xf), sets bit 0 of 0x12ec8 (prompt open) and copies the old prompt flag 0x12da0 into bit 1, sets the flag to 1 and the duel setup buffer word +0x854 to 1. Button 2 ends the lesson (duel_core_tutorial_update_quit_prompt); the texts are not in this code (meaning of the prompt: hypothesis "quit tutorial", confidence medium). No return value. Side effects: 0x12da8-0x12ec8, 0x12da0, duel setup +0x854. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_update_overlay).

column2: void * duel_core_tutorial_draw_card_icon(void *list, int x, int y, int icon)
column3: Binds card_icon02.gim from the duel archive (ui_load_duel_archive_80001, container_ehp_find_member) and draws the 16 x 16 cell (icon % 8, icon / 8) at (x, y) in white. Returns the advanced list pointer (hypothesis from the caller, confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all).

Temporarily terminates text at its first newline, sets shadow on, scale 0xe and font flag 1, and returns duel_core_tutorial_measure_text_height(width, text) (system_font_split_lines(width, text, 0, 0)): the height in 1/64 pixel of the first line wrapped to width, also in 1/64 pixel (the only caller passes 0x6a80 = 0x1aa << 6, a plain constant that Ghidra shows as a function address); the newline is restored. Returns 0 when the text has no newline. Side effects: font state. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_open_list_window).

Returns the height in 1/64 pixel of text wrapped to width: tail-jumps to system_font_split_lines(width, text, 0, 0) (same code as BOOT.BIN system_font_measure_text_height). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_measure_caption).
Module entry point of rel_tutorial (ELF e_entry 0x1b10), with nothing to do. Returns 0 at once. No side effects. No direct caller (run by the module loader through e_entry).
Returns the word 0x12da0 (prompt flag, set to 1 when the quit prompt opens). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_open_quit_prompt).
Writes value to the word 0x12da0. No return value. Side effects: 0x12da0. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_open_quit_prompt).

Clears the overlay block 0x12f28 (0x604 bytes, starting with the overlay list pointer) and the highlight record 0 at 0x12ef8 (0xc bytes). No return value. Side effects: 0x12ef8-0x12f03, 0x12f28-0x1352b. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_init).

Empty function: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set); first of three empty calls of duel_core_tutorial_cleanup, probably a hook left empty in this build (hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_cleanup).

Selects GE layer 9 and sets the sprite render state (states 0, 3, 1, 10, 2 off; 9 and 4 on; alpha blend; white colour and ambient; nearest filter), storing the list pointer at 0x12f28. No return value. Side effects: 0x12f28, GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight_layer).
Commits list as the layer pointer (system_ge_commit_layer_pointer) and clears 0x12f28. No return value. Side effects: layer pointer, 0x12f28. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight_layer).

Writes clear colour/depth/stencil 0, disables GE states 0, 3, 1, 10, 2, enables 9 and 4, alpha blend (0, 2, 3), white colour, nearest filter and white ambient. Returns the advanced list pointer (hypothesis from the callers, confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 3 (duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_face, duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite, duel_core_tutorial_msgwin_draw_all).

Same setup as duel_core_tutorial_set_sprite_render_state but with state 9 (texturing) disabled and colour 0xd0000000 (untextured dark quads). Returns the advanced list pointer (hypothesis from the caller, confidence medium). Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_draw_sprite_scaled_noflip(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int u, int v, int tex_w, int tex_h)

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_draw_sprite_scaled(void *list, int x, int y, int width, int height, int u, int v, int tex_w, int tex_h, int flip_uv, int flip_xy)
column3: Draws one sprite from the bound texture: system_ge_set_sprite_extent(list, tex_w, tex_h, width, height) (texture size first, drawn size second, as the extent is used elsewhere in these modules) and system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped(list, x, y, 0, u, v, flip_uv, flip_xy). Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3, 9-11 on the stack. Returns nothing usable. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_gim_sprite, duel_core_tutorial_draw_sprite_scaled_noflip).

Spotlight effect: clears the stencil, draws the current rectangles of highlight records 0 and 1 (0x12f10.. and 0x12f1c.., when their flag byte is set) into the stencil with colour 0, then, if either is active, draws a full-screen 0x1e0 x 0x110 quad in 0xc0000000 where the stencil is clear (darkening everything outside the highlights); clears the stencil again and disables stencil testing. No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight).
Clears highlight record index (0-2) at 0x12ef8 + 0xc * index. No return value. Side effects: that record. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_animate_highlights).

Steps highlight records 0 and 1 (0x12ef8, 0xc bytes each: state byte, target x, y, right/width, bottom/height shorts at +2..+8, step +0xa) and mirrors the state into the current-rectangle records at 0x12f10: state 1 (opening) shrinks the rectangle from the full 480 x 272 screen to the target in 10 steps, then state 2 and the target is copied; state 3 (closing) grows it back in 10 steps and then clears the record. No return value. Side effects: 0x12ef8-0x12f27. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight).
Copies a 12-byte highlight record (byte +0 and the shorts +2..+0xa) from src to dst and returns dst. Side effects: dst. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_animate_highlights).

Animates the highlight records, sets the dim render state and draws the stencil spotlight (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight_mask). No return value. Side effects: highlight records, GE commands. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_highlight_layer).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_start_highlight(int index, short x, short y, short width, short height)
column3: For index 0-2, sets highlight record index to state 1 (opening) with the target rectangle (shorts +2, +4, +6, +8 at 0x12ef8 + 0xc * index). No return value. Side effects: that record. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_highlight_region, duel_core_tutorial_highlight_card_part).

For index 0-2, sets a non-zero highlight record state to 3 (closing). No return value. Side effects: that record. Callers: 3 (duel_core_tutorial_highlight_region, duel_core_tutorial_stop_region_highlight, duel_core_tutorial_highlight_card_part).
Returns the state byte of highlight record index (0 off, 1 opening, 2 shown, 3 closing). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_get_region_highlight_state).

Returns the unsigned short 0x17d9a, the card whose ATK the $1-$4 placeholders print (nothing in the code read writes it; hypothesis, confidence medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_format_placeholder).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00002654; nop) to duel_core_tutorial_bind_heap. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of duel_core_tutorial_bind_heap (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/duel_core.md). Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_init).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00002678; nop) to duel_core_tutorial_unbind_heap. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of duel_core_tutorial_unbind_heap (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/duel_core.md). Callers: 1 (FUN_00005fd4).

Copies the UTF-16 string src into dst, at most max_chars characters including the terminator, always NUL-terminated. Returns the number of characters copied. Side effects: dst. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_draw_question_item).

Appends the UTF-16 string src to dst within max_chars characters, NUL-terminating. Returns the new length, or -1 when dst has no terminator within max_chars. Side effects: dst. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_expand_placeholders).

column2: void duel_core_tutorial_format_placeholder(int index, int unused, ushort *out)
column3: Formats placeholder $<index> into out: 0 prints the player name (save_get_player_name) with the 9-character format at 0xf770; 1-4 print, when the placeholder card 0x17d9a is set, its ATK (card_db_get_atk_or_unknown) with the format at 0xf784, halved for index >= 2, + 200 for index >= 3 and + 500 more for index 4. No return value. Side effects: out. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_expand_placeholders).

column2: int duel_core_tutorial_on_ui_event(uint event, uint arg1, uint arg2, int arg3)

Returns 1 to forward the event, 0 to swallow it. Side effects: tutorial state words, hint, dialog answer. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_ui_event_hook); exported (1 import stub without caller).

Duel-flow gate hook: returns 0 for lessons >= 20 and in states 4, 6 and 8 (the engine may run); state 2 calls duel_core_tutorial_wait_ui_idle and state 3 duel_core_tutorial_wait_message, and these and all other states return 1 (hold the duel flow). Side effects: state 0x17f2c, answer 0x17f58 (through the called functions). Exported (registered with duel_core_set_duel_flow_gate_hook; 1 import stub without caller).

In state 4, compares the field cursor (duel_core_tutorial_read_cursor_position, card under the cursor) with the awaited wait_input: kind 12 a spell/trap zone (5-9), kind 6 a monster zone (0-4), kind 0 own side zone 11 (hand); with the awaited card 0x17f3c 0 or equal to the card, resumes the script (state 1). No return value. Side effects: state 0x17f2c, cursor block 0x18764. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_card_action_auto_choose); exported (1 import stub without caller).

Jumps to the label of the pending on_event handler (0x17f40), clears the handler event 0x17f3e and sets state 1. No return value. Side effects: program counter 0x17f34, 0x17f3e, 0x17f2c. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_update); exported (1 import stub without caller).

Confirm-prompt validator (ui_set_confirm_prompt_validator): in state 4 with wait_input kind 13, prompts 2 and 3 accept only answer 1 (returns 0 otherwise) and resume the script (state 1); any other prompt sets state 2. Returns 1 to accept, 0 to refuse. Side effects: state 0x17f2c. Exported (registered as a callback; 1 import stub without caller).
Re-shows the remembered hint line 0x17f48 (duel_core_tutorial_show_hint) when it is not negative. No return value. Side effects: hint window. Exported (1 import stub without caller).

Returns 1 while the quit prompt is open (bit 0 of 0x12ec8); otherwise 0 for lessons >= 20 and in states 4 and 6, else 1. Side effects: none. Exported; called from rel_duel_mgr (1: system_duel_mgr_run_tutorial).

Records the end flag 0x18760; on the first transition to 1 starts a 0x10-frame black fade-out. No return value. Side effects: 0x18760, fade. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_update_quit_prompt, duel_core_tutorial_init).
Returns 1 when the end flag 0x18760 is 1 and the fade has finished (system_is_fade_done), else 0. No side effects. No direct caller (export, 0 callers in the pack).

Returns the script record at the program counter 0x17f34 and advances it by 8 (the decompiler shows only the increment; return from the caller's use). Side effects: 0x17f34. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_step).

Executes tutorial command record[0] & 0x3fff (jump table 0xf608): 1 message, 2 hint, 3 hint off, 4 highlight (region record[2], side record[1], timer record[3], state 7), 6 goto, 7 if_answer, 8 question (line count = newlines), 9 show_card (1/2 from 0x17f50), 10 load_field, 11 wait, 12 wait_input, 13 set_turn (duel_core_set_turn_counter), 14 wait_event, 15 card_part, 16 on_event, 17/18 flag on/off (bit 3 also duel_core_tutorial_apply_setup_flag), 19 count_answer, 20 open_list (duel_core_submit_player_action(side, location, 0, 1), state 2). Returns 0 to continue with the next record and 1 to stop for this frame (also for 0, 5 label and unknown codes). Side effects: tutorial state, windows, duel engine. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_step).
Returns 0x18790, the object handle passed to duel_core_tutorial_after_action_noop by command 0x14. No side effects. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command).

Returns 0x18788, the handle passed to the marker stubs. No side effects. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command, duel_core_tutorial_update_highlight_timer).

Returns 0x18780, the handle passed to the hint window helpers. No side effects. Callers: 3 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command, duel_core_tutorial_hide_hint, duel_core_tutorial_show_hint).
Returns 0x1877c, the handle passed to the message and question helpers. No side effects. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command, duel_core_tutorial_wait_message).

Returns 1 after a stopping record. Side effects: as the handlers. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_update).

State 3 of the gate: once neither the message (slot 8) nor the question (slot 6) window is open, copies duel_core_get_dialog_answer() to 0x17f58 and resumes the script (state 1). No return value. Side effects: 0x17f58, 0x17f2c. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_gate_duel_flow).

Loads text line line of d_tutorial/tutorial/tuto_text_%c.bin ("jegfis"[language & 7], language byte 0x187a0) through the file helpers: reads the 8-byte (offset, size) pair at 8 * line, then size bytes at offset into the buffer 0x17f60. Command 12: state 4 with the awaited input kind 0x17f3a and card 0x17f3c (the record's third argument is passed but unused). No return value. Side effects: 0x17f2c, 0x17f3a, 0x17f3c. Callers: 1 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command).

Searches the script 0x17f30 from its start for a label record (op & 0x3fff = 5) with argument label and sets the program counter 0x17f34 to the record after it; nothing happens when op 0 is reached first. No return value. Side effects: 0x17f34. Callers: 3 (duel_core_tutorial_exec_command, duel_core_tutorial_fire_event_handler, duel_core_tutorial_on_ui_event).

Closes the hint window (duel_core_tutorial_close_hint_window) and forgets the hint line (0x17f48 = -1). No return value. Side effects: slot 7, 0x17f48. Callers: 2 (duel_core_tutorial_filter_input, duel_core_tutorial_on_ui_event).
